What will you do
At Arrow, you’ll handle all kinds of cool electronic products shipped across Europe. On your first day as Warehouse Worker, you’ll be paired with a buddy to help you settle in, how great is that? You’ll scan, register, and check items to make sure everything’s perfect. When it’s time to recharge, enjoy a fresh meal in our cafeteria or relax on the rooftop terrace! Your tasks will include:

- Unloading trucks and registering goods in the system using computers.
- Picking orders at the pick stations.
- Scanning products and packing them carefully.
- Stacking pallets and loading trucks.
- Working with computers and digital systems to process orders correctly.
- Driving an electric pallet truck.
